answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, published publicly on failure, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the sable of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the bridge re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. What survives to the cedar is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
